summary: Best current practices for third party call control in SIP, where one party sets up a call in which the communication is actually between other parties. SIP allows several approaches, each with trade-offs, and this document discusses which are good to use. It is a best current practice, not a protocol specification.

eli5.summary: Imagine a receptionist who dials two people and connects them to each other, without joining the call. This explains good ways to do that using internet phone calls.
